text: have lost, I will earn back piece by piece at Hoshimi's operating tables."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji Sakaguchi nodded:

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "If you need case accumulation and collaboration with colleagues, please come to me at any time."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji raised her eyebrows slightly:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Let me be clear in advance, Dr. Sakaguchi: the next time we are in the operating room, I will still point out every problem that needs to be addressed."

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "That's just what I want."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji looked at him, her voice softening:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "And thank you for not lecturing me or treating us as people who can do nothing but accept protection."

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Neither are you."

speaker: Narrator
text: A faint smile touched the corner of Narumi's lips.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "...I like that answer."

speaker: Narrator
text: The office door opened and Ren Nanase poked her head inside.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "You two! If there is no urgent surgery right now, could you come to the lounge and help me with a very serious problem?"

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "What's the problem?"

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "I bought three sandwiches for us. Then Dr. Mizuki heard there was food and followed me. She is standing outside the lounge with her laptop, saying she can show us three papers she just finished while we eat—and that

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: this time she even remembered to submit them!"

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "...Three papers?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi laughed so hard that she had to steady herself against the bookshelf.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Let's go. We cannot let her put the sandwiches on top of her papers."

speaker: Narrator
text: The three of them left the surgical office together and headed toward the lively staff lounge.

speaker: Narrator
text: The pelvic imaging report on the desk lay open to its third page.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji Sakaguchi studied the grayscale images on the lightbox and monitor, then enlarged one section.

speaker: Narrator
text: The young woman seated across from him was Yayoi Kunizuka, age twenty-four. Her long hair was neatly arranged, and she wore a subdued knit cardigan. With both hands resting properly on her knees, she looked quiet and

speaker: Narrator
text: self-possessed, though the fatigue of living with chronic pain still showed between her brows.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "How long has the pain in your lower abdomen lasted?"

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "More than two years. The attacks have become much more frequent over the past six months. Some days I can barely stay on my feet or make it through work."

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "How effective was the conservative drug treatment you received at the other hospital?"

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "It worked at first. After I stopped taking the medicine... I was almost back to square one."

speaker: Narrator
text: Sakaguchi opened the records from her previous examinations.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "There is a clear endometriotic cyst on the left ovary, along with lesions near the deep posterior fornix. The MRI suggests fairly complex local adhesions."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi's fingers tightened slightly.

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "Does surgery have to be done?"

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "You do not have to decide this very minute. First, let me explain what continued medical management can do, what open surgery may resolve, and what surgery cannot promise to resolve completely."

speaker: Narrator
text: Some of the tension left Yayoi's shoulders.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "If you decide to undergo surgery, our core goals are to remove the painful lesions and loosen deep adhesions, while preserving as much normal ovarian cortex on your left side as possible to avoid unnecessary organ

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: damage."

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "I want to be cured."

speaker: Narrator
text: Her answer was decisive, as though she had already weighed the choice over and over before coming here.

speaker: Narrator
text: Then she took a neatly sealed referral letter from her folder and slid it across the desk.

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "Actually... another doctor recommended that I make an appointment with you at Hoshimi Hospital."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji Sakaguchi received the letter:

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Which doctor?"

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "A specialist in gynecology. I previously handled external data organization and research coordination for his group, and I also consulted him about my condition. He said Hoshimi Hospital had recently hired a highly

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: versatile surgeon who returned from overseas."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji Sakaguchi responded gently while opening the envelope:

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "That is a generous introduction. What is the doctor's name?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi paused, her calm gaze resting on Sakaguchi.

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "Ryuji Hirasaka."

speaker: Narrator
text: Sakaguchi's fingers paused as he unfolded the letter.

speaker: Narrator
text: A familiar signature appeared at the bottom of the page.

speaker: Narrator
text: During a ten-minute meeting in the director's office a few days earlier, Asuka Jogu's words echoed in Sakaguchi's mind—『Someone like Hirasaka might not readily believe Mika Shimotsuki's fabricated report... If he

speaker: Narrator
text: keeps probing Hoshimi by subtler means, he may approach your surgical clinic directly.』

speaker: Narrator
text: Sure enough, the other party came, and this time the person sent was no longer a device salesman, but a real patient with complex pelvic lesions in urgent need of surgical treatment.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji Sakaguchi kept his expression perfectly natural as he slipped the referral letter into the patient's chart.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Understood. I will keep the referral letter, but in this consulting room, we will discuss only your condition."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi Kunizuka raised her head slightly and gave him a surprised glance.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "No matter who referred you, only one question matters here: what treatment do you need?"

speaker: Narrator
text: After the afternoon clinic ended, Sakaguchi brought Yayoi's pelvic films and admission assessment to the surgical office.

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi stood at the lightbox and studied the images for a long while.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Deep infiltrating lesions are far more difficult than an ordinary endometrioma. Judging only from her outpatient complaint, one might assume this was a simple ovarian cyst, but adhesions along the posterior wall and

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: beneath the broad ligament have already distorted the left adnexa."

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Where's your assessment?"

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "If she decides to have open surgery, she must not just remove the cyst. The adhesions and ectopic nodules in the deep pelvic cavity must be carefully released at the same time, otherwise the postoperative pain will

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: not be relieved at all."

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "It's exactly what I thought. And she is only twenty-four years old. The priority of protecting normal ovarian tissue must be thoroughly explained to her before the operation."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji nodded:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "I will cooperate with you to complete the pre-operative conversation plan."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji Sakaguchi drew the referral letter from the bottom of the chart folder and set it gently on the desk in front of Narumi.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "There is one more thing you need to know right away."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji looked down at the name on the letterhead.

speaker: Narrator
text: Her pen stopped in midair. Without writing another mark, she quietly set down the imaging report.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "...Ryuji Hirasaka. What the director feared has happened after all."

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Mika Shimotsuki's report claiming she had found no such people failed to dispel his suspicions completely."

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "With his character, as long as there is a trace of doubt, he will definitely try the second method again. Is this patient... real or fake?"

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "The disease is real. The history of dysmenorrhea, physical signs, ultrasound and magnetic resonance imaging for more than two years are completely consistent, and it is indeed necessary for surgical intervention."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji took a gentle breath:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "I understand. No matter who is writing the letter of introduction in her hand, since she walked into Hoshimi Hospital with a real illness, this will not change."

speaker: Narrator
text: There was a gentle knock on the office door, and Ren Nanase walked in holding a stack of preoperative care records.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Doctor Narumi, Dr. Sakaguchi, this is from tomorrow's ward——"

speaker: Narrator
text: Halfway through her words, she was keenly aware of the solemn expressions on the two people's faces, and her footsteps suddenly stopped.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "...What's wrong?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji did not hide anything and spoke softly:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Hirasaka sent someone to meet with the star again."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase's fingers holding the record folder tightened silently. She first looked at Ryuji Sakaguchi, then turned to Narumi:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "What is the identity of the person coming this time?"

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Patient. Name is Yayoi Kunizuka, 24 years old. left ovarian endometrioma has deep pelvic adhesions."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase was startled for a moment:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Is this a real patient?"

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Absolutely true."

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Since he came openly through a legitimate referral, we will answer his move with an impeccable operation."

speaker: Narrator
text: A determined glint crossed Narumi Jinguji's eyes, and she nodded softly.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "That's right. In the professional fields we are most familiar with, we have no reason to back down."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase looked at Narumi:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "We'll deal with other troubles after her illness is cured."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji smiled lightly:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Yes. Let's report this to the director first."

speaker: Narrator
text: After hearing the three of them out, Asuka closed the administrative papers she had been about to sign and set them aside.

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "Sending a second person here so quickly... It seems that Hirasaka is more suspicious than we thought."

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "And this time he learned to be clever. Instead of sending a sales representative to wander through the hospital, he referred a young woman who had handled data for his group and genuinely needed surgery for a complex

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: gynecological condition."

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "Ms. KunizukaDid you test anything in the clinic?"

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "No. Apart from voluntarily handing over Hirasaka's letter of recommendation, I talked about my condition seriously throughout the whole process and did not inquire about anyone else in the hospital."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji took a step forward:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Director, if Ms. Kunizuka decides to undergo surgery at Hoshimi, I would like to request to join the surgical team."

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka Jogu raised her eyes and looked at her:

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "In what capacity?"

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "As the first assistant, I am responsible for her preoperative care. I have done long-term research on the anatomical layers of deep pelvic endometriosis, and I also have experience in cooperating with complex

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: adhesions dissection."

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "I support the plan. The deep lesions are in a very difficult location. With Dr. Jinguji as first assistant, we will have a much better chance of preserving healthy ovarian tissue."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase also spoke:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Director, I would also like permission to scrub in as the instrument nurse."

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka Jogu's eyes stayed on the faces of Narumi and Ren for a moment, and their expressions became extremely serious.

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "Ren, Narumi—you both understand that the moment you appear in her ward and operating room, you will be confirming with your own hands that the people Hirasaka is seeking are at Hoshimi."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren met Asuka's gaze and nodded without hesitation.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "I know."

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "I don't want what happened last time in the backup operating room to happen again."

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Absolutely not. This time she is a genuine patient, and I am responsible for the instruments and perioperative nursing. She is coming to the operating table to be treated, not interrogated."

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Me too. No matter what she reports to Hirasaka after surgery, I will not do anything medically."

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka was silent for a while, and her tense eyebrows gradually relaxed.

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "Very well. The clinical roster will be determined by the needs of the case and each person's qualifications. I approve the three of you forming the team for this case, with the experienced Mika Nakai assigned as

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: circulating nurse. The previous violation will remain in the internal record. I will not relax medical standards simply because you know the person behind this—but I trust your professionalism as doctors and nurses."

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Understood."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji and Ren Nanase bow their heads at the same time:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Thank you, Director."

speaker: Narrator
text: After dark, the main lights in the ward have been dimmed.

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi, now wearing a hospital gown, sat quietly on the edge of the bed. A novel with a worn, faded cover and several neatly folded pages of sheet music lay on the bedside table.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase walked in with a ward round board and gently checked the pre-operative preparations.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Ms. Kunizuka, I will confirm with you the pre-operative arrangements for tomorrow."

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "Sorry to trouble you."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren followed the standard procedure to check the patient's name, the name of the planned open surgery, epidural anesthesia's positioning instructions, and the evening fasting and watering time, and then asked her

speaker: Narrator
text: softly if she had any unresolved questions.

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi Kunizuka shook her head.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren did not turn around and leave in a hurry, her eyes fell on the novel on the bedside.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "I noticed when I came in. You kept the book open, but you did not seem to turn a single page."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi Kunizuka looked down at the page and said lightly:

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "It's been discovered."

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "It is normal for me to be unable to sleep the night before the surgery and feel nervous when I undergo open pelvic surgery for the first time."

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "I'm not afraid of pain."

speaker: Narrator
text: She paused, looked at the folds on the sheets, and added honestly:

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "...It's not like I'm not afraid at all."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase pulled the stool beside the bed and sat down, speaking in a gentle and patient tone:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Then we're not in a hurry. There's still a while before lights out, so you can start with whatever you want."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi Kunizuka raised her eyes and quietly studied the young nurse before her.

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "I heard the nurse doing rounds this afternoon mention that the person who will be the first assistant to Dr. Sakaguchi tomorrow will be a doctor named Narumi Jinguji?"

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Yes."

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "Then... nurse Ren Nanase will also be in the operating room tomorrow?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase nodded calmly:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "I'm responsible for tomorrow's instrument table."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi Kunizuka lowered her eyelashes and was silent for a moment.

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "Do you know who sent me?"

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "I know your name is Yayoi Kunizuka, you are twenty-four, and you are scheduled for surgery tomorrow morning."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi Kunizuka was stunned for a moment, and the corners of her lips raised a slight arc:

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "What an amazing answer."

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Because that's the truth."

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "Then what if I told you that, besides coming here for treatment with Dr. Hirasaka's referral letter, I also agreed to verify something for him?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase didn't show any surprise or hostility on her face.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "As long as it doesn't interfere with tomorrow's treatment and postoperative recovery, you can decide when to talk about it."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi Kunizuka looked at her with some confusion:

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "...You don't want to force me to question you, and you're not afraid that I'll go back and tell him?"

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "More importantly, as your nurse tonight, I want to know whether you were staring at that book because you are still worried about tomorrow's operation but feel too embarrassed to ask us about it."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi regarded Ren in silence for a long moment.

speaker: Narrator
text: Only the steady beeping of the monitor filled the ward. After a moment, the usually composed young woman lowered her voice almost to a whisper.

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "After the operation...can I really decide where to go and what work to do?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase looked into her eyes seriously and answered word by word:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Of course. During the hospitalization, we will arrange care and discharge evaluation based on your recovery, but your life is not part of the surgical consent form."

speaker: Narrator
text: Moisture gathered in Yayoi's eyes. She drew a careful breath.

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "...That's it."

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Do you have any other questions about tomorrow's condition itself?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi Kunizuka lowered her head and pressed her left lower abdomen:

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "Yes. This disease has been tormenting me for more than two years. I'm afraid that after getting a knife, the pain will come back after a while, and I'm afraid that normal tissue will not be preserved."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase stood up:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "The surgeons need to explain that to you properly from a professional standpoint. I will contact Dr. Sakaguchi now and ask him and Dr. Jinguji to go over the details with you in person during tomorrow morning's

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: preoperative discussion. All right?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi Kunizuka hesitated:

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "Are you going to bother the surgeon so late at night?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase smiled:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Don't worry, our Hoshimi surgeon is already used to being called upon by me in the middle of the night to register patients' questions."

speaker: Narrator
text: Looking at Ren's bright and determined smile, Yayoi Kunizuka's eyebrows, which had been tense all night, finally softened.

speaker: Narrator
text: Sakaguchi and Narumi spread the preoperative information sheets, including diagrams of the pelvic anatomy, in front of Yayoi.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Ms. Kunizuka, Nurse Nanase conveyed your concerns to us last night. Today's open surgery uses epidural anesthesia, and you will remain conscious during the operation; the surgical plan is to completely remove the

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: endometrioma cyst on the left ovary, and at the same time release the adhesions and ectopic lesions in the deep pelvic cavity."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji Use the tip of the pen to gently tap on the area behind the ovarian hilus and broad ligament in the map:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Preserving healthy tissue and its blood supply will be our first priority. But in the interest of medical honesty, we cannot promise you an absolute outcome before we open the abdomen. The true extent of excision and

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: adhesiolysis will depend on what we actually find during surgery."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji Sakaguchi added:

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Endometriosis does carry a long-term risk of recurrence. In a very small number of cases, densely infiltrating lesions must also be treated in stages to protect adjacent organs. Even so, removing the major existing

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: lesions and releasing the adhesions under tension should significantly relieve your pain and improve your quality of life."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi listened with complete attention.

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "What if it is discovered during the operation that the adhesions in some places are more complicated than what the magnetic resonance imaging shows?"

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "We will only choose the safest and most functional anatomical level for separation within the scope of the surgery that you signed and agreed to, and will never expand the unauthorized scope of resection without

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: authorization."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi gave a small nod.

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "Nurse Nanase also told me last night that a real doctor will not give a false promise just because the patient wants to hear a beautiful promise."

speaker: Narrator
text: She picked up the pen on the table and without any further hesitation, she signed the five words "Yayoi Kunizuka" one stroke at a time on the "Informed Consent Form for Open Left Ovarian Cyst Removal and Deep Pelvic

speaker: Narrator
text: Lesion Release" with her real name printed on it.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji Sakaguchi put away the signed consent form:

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Thank you for your trust. We will do our best."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi Kunizuka closed the pen cap and raised her head to look at Narumi Jinguji opposite.

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "Dr. Jinguji, you have known Dr. Hirasaka before, right?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji did not avoid her gaze:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "We know each other."

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "When he recommended me to come to Hoshimi Hospital for surgery, he also asked me to confirm for him. You three may have already guessed it."

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Yes."

speaker: Narrator
text: There was a hint of real doubt in Yayoi Kunizuka's eyes:

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "If you know I came here to act as his eyes, why did you still volunteer to scrub in and help operate on me?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji looked at the folder in her hand and answered calmly and gently:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Because what you just signed was an informed consent form for surgery—not a guarantee to do anything for anyone."

speaker: Narrator
text: When Yayoi Kunizuka was pushed into the No. 1 operating room by gurney, it was even quieter than in the ward.

speaker: Narrator
text: She looked up at the surgical light, not yet turned to full brightness, then saw Ren Nanase counting instruments beside the sterile instrument table and circulating nurse Mika Nakai preparing the monitors near the

speaker: Narrator
text: operating table.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren was already in a sterile gown, surgical cap, and mask. At the sound of the gurney, she turned toward Yayoi, her eyes crinkling in a reassuring smile.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Ms. Kunizuka, good morning."

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "...Good morning, Nurse Nanase."

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Today in the operating room, you only need to remember one thing: All of us are standing here to complete the surgery you just signed for."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi Kunizuka looked at those clear and determined eyes, and her tight breathing gradually calmed down.

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "...Yeah. Please."

speaker: Narrator
text: [epidural anesthesia and preoperative preparation completed]

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji had completed Yayoi Kunizuka's epidural catheter placement and sensory-level check as planned. All preoperative preparations and sterile draping were ready. After scrubbing, gowning, and gloving, Narumi

speaker: Narrator
text: took her position as first assistant opposite Ryuji Sakaguchi.

speaker: Narrator
text: surgical light overhead suddenly lit up. Mika Nakai, who serves as circulating nurse, stood next to the headside monitor and completed the final check before the operation.

speaker: Mika Nakai
text: "Patient Yayoi Kunizuka underwent open left ovarian endometrioma dissection and pelvic adhesiolysis. The surgical site and scope of the consent form were time-out verified by three parties. epidural anesthesia has a

speaker: Mika Nakai
text: stable block plane and stable vital signs."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji Sakaguchi looked toward Narumi at the first-assistant position and extended his right hand:

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Let's begin. Scalpel."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase moved the scalpel neatly into Sakaguchi's palm.

speaker: Narrator
text: 【Surgery in progress】

speaker: Narrator
text: Under epidural anesthesia, the awake Yayoi Kunizuka felt no sharp pain as the lower abdominal incision was opened layer by layer. Behind the anesthesia screen and drapes, she could hear only the faint clink of

speaker: Narrator
text: instruments and the steady breathing of the surgical team.

speaker: Narrator
text: After entering the pelvic cavity, the real situation in the field of vision was as difficult as Narumi predicted before the operation. The surface of the left ovary was covered with dense fibrous adhesions, and the

speaker: Narrator
text: deep lesions tightly pulled the posterior side of the ovary, the posterior leaf of the broad ligament, and the uterine-rectal fossa together.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "The left appendage is tightly pulled by deep adhesions, and direct removal of the cyst can easily tear the capsule."

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Don't move the cyst itself in a hurry. Let's first release the tension of the deep adhesions and expose the basal layer."

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Okay. You are responsible for controlling the traction tension, and I will cut in from the outside avascular zone."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji firmly held the wet saline gauze and deep retractor with both hands, and accurately adjusted the traction angle.

speaker: Narrator
text: As the deep pelvic tissues were gently retracted, Yayoi Kunizuka felt a distinct dull pressure and pulling sensation deep in her lower abdomen beneath the drapes, and instinctively held her breath.

speaker: Narrator
text: Circulating nurse Mika Nakai, stationed at the head of the table, immediately noticed the slight rise in Yayoi's heart rate and reassured her gently:

speaker: Mika Nakai
text: "Ms. Kunizuka, the doctors are releasing the adhesions deep in your pelvis now. Some pressure and pulling inside your abdomen is normal. Just follow me and take slow, deep breaths."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase next to instrument table also added warmly: "It's going very well, please relax your shoulders."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi Kunizuka answered softly and listened quietly to the team at work beneath the drapes.

speaker: Narrator
text: After their earlier experience operating together, Sakaguchi and Narumi needed almost no extra explanation as they exposed the confined deep pelvic operative field one layer at a time.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Wait. This dense nodule lies too close to the critical structure beneath it. We cannot continue along the same plane."

speaker: Narrator
text: Sakaguchi stopped the dissecting scissors at once.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "I see it. Let's gradually separate from the loose gap above."

speaker: Narrator
text: The instant Sakaguchi shifted his gaze, Ren Nanase had already placed fresh fine dissecting forceps and a small gauze pledget within his reach.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Dissecting forceps and a gauze pledget are ready."

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Thank you. Perfect timing."

speaker: Narrator
text: There are no thrilling emergencies in this operation. The real test lies in the ultimate patience and anatomy skills - identifying the boundaries between diseased fibers and normal tissue in deep adhesions bit by bit,

speaker: Narrator
text: without sacrificing the goal of preserving normal tissue for the sake of speed.

speaker: Narrator
text: When the peeling is advanced to the core-basal junction, Narumi Jinguji uses non-damaging tweezers to gently tap out a hidden dividing layer.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Dr. Sakaguchi, look here. This is a situation I have encountered repeatedly in clinical research before - it looks like a whole piece of adhesion on the image, but during the actual treatment, it is divided in the

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: opposite direction along this gap, and the deep lesions can be completely peeled off without damaging the normal ovarian tissue."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji Sakaguchi followed her guidance and dealt with it step by step, and the difficult adhesion clumps were smoothly untied.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Your layered approach really comes in handy here."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi's eyes curved into a smile above her mask.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Don't rush to praise me yet, there's still the last part to come."

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Okay, continue."

speaker: Narrator
text: Lying on the operating table, Yayoi listened as the two surgeons repeatedly confirmed each tissue plane in their effort to preserve healthy ovarian tissue. Hidden in the shadow beneath the drapes, the corners of her

speaker: Narrator
text: eyes grew damp.

speaker: Narrator
text: A few hours later, the left ovarian cyst and deep ectopic lesions were treated as scheduled, and the remaining normal ovarian tissue was carefully sutured and repositioned steadily.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Check for hemostasis and confirm the condition of the remaining tissue."

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "The wound was completely hemostatic and the preserved ovarian tissue was in good condition."

speaker: Mika Nakai
text: "epidural anesthesia's status and vital signs are stable throughout."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase and Mika Nakai jointly completed the inventory of instruments, gauze and suture needles:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "The instruments, gauze, and suture needles are all correctly counted and the numbers match."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji Sakaguchi breathed out gently:

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "As planned abdominal closure. It's over, everyone has worked hard."

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Thank you for your hard work."

speaker: Narrator
text: After abdominal closure and dressing, Mika Nakai removed the drapes and, together with an orderly, transferred the conscious and reassured Yayoi Kunizuka smoothly onto a gurney for transport back to the ward.

speaker: Narrator
text: Sunlight shines through the blinds in the ward at the foot of the bed.

speaker: Narrator
text: The numbness in Yayoi's lower limbs from the epidural had completely resolved. Ryuji Sakaguchi had just finished reviewing her postoperative vital-sign record and wound dressing; Narumi Jinguji and Ren Nanase stood

speaker: Narrator
text: beside the bed.

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "Yesterday on the operating table... I heard everything. I still want to ask again, how is your recovery?"

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "The operation was completed exactly as planned. We treated the deep adhesions and lesions appropriately, and your recovery is stable so far. We will continue to monitor you closely."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji warmly added:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "The normal left ovarian tissue that you are most worried about has been preserved as completely as possible. Although the final pathology report will still have to wait a few days, the main lesion that has troubled

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: you for more than two years has been eliminated."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi Kunizuka listened in a daze, and then took a long breath, and the tight shoulder lines completely relaxed.

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "Thank you...I really appreciate it."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase adjusted the height of the bed for her:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Have a good rest in the next few days, and don't worry about other things."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi shook her head. The calm candor she showed at work had returned to her eyes.

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "No. There is something I want to tell you clearly, face to face, right now."

speaker: Narrator
text: The ward fell silent and no one interrupted her.

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "When Dr. Hirasaka wrote the referral that brought me to Hoshimi Hospital, he did ask me to verify one thing for him: whether Narumi Jinguji and Ren Nanase were truly here."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji nodded calmly:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Understood."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi lightly gripped the edge of the blanket with both hands and looked directly at the three of them.

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "I have seen you with my own eyes, and heard your cooperation with my ears on the operating table yesterday. When I recover better, I will report to him truthfully - including the two of you who performed this

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: operation for me together with Dr. Sakaguchi."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase said nothing.

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "Do you... want me to do what the last person did and say that I didn't find it for you?"

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "No. If you want to tell him the truth, tell him the truth."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi blinked in surprise.

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "...Really?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji SakaguchiClose the ward round record folder:

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Your operation has been completed, and you can recover as planned. As for how you explain to Hirasaka, it is up to you."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi Kunizuka looked at Ryuji Sakaguchi, then looked at Narumi and Ren who looked calm.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase smiled gently:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Let's think about it slowly after my body recovers."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi Kunizuka showed a helpless and sincere smile:

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "The people in your hospital are so weird."

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "We have already heard this comment."

speaker: Narrator
text: For the first time, Yayoi Kunizuka really laughed out loud.

speaker: Narrator
text: On Asuka Jogu's desk is a copy of the inquiry letter just transferred from an external cooperation agency.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji Sakaguchi, Narumi Jinguji and Ren Nanase are sitting across from the reception area.

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "Ms. Kunizuka is still recovering in the ward, but as she promised before admission, she has already given Hirasaka an honest report. This morning he used a partner organization to inquire about Hoshimi's staffing.

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: The question was very politely phrased—and very specific."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren NanaseClenched her fingers gently:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "...He has indeed confirmed that we are here."

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "I have explicitly rejected every attempt by an outside organization to use a partnership to interfere with this hospital's staffing. But we all know he will not limit himself to official channels."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji looked calm:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Yes. What he is best at is using his network of connections to test and exert pressure little by little until the opponent thinks there is no other choice but to obey him."

speaker: Narrator
text: The office was quiet for a moment.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji Sakaguchi looked at the letters on the table and said:

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Since we can't rely on others to lie for us, and administrative rejection alone can't stop him, I have a suggestion."

speaker: Narrator
text: The three people's eyes were focused on Sakaguchi at the same time.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "We should transfer some benefits to Hirasaka - not to plead with him, but to put the pressure of external verification and the substantial benefits he can get at the same time on the table, so that he has sufficient

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: reasons to stop the investigation on his own initiative."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase opened her eyes wide in surprise:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Transferring benefits...? This sounds like rewarding him."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji did not show any surprise. She tapped the armrest with her fingertips and quickly took over Sakaguchi's thoughts:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "No. Dr. Sakaguchi's calculation is correct. Hirasaka has never been the sort to retreat merely because he is frightened, but no one is better at weighing gains and losses. If continuing the investigation carries a

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: genuinely damaging risk while stopping gives him a coveted benefit for free, he will choose the course most profitable to him."

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "It sounds as though Dr. Jinguji has already decided what leverage to use against him."

speaker: Narrator
text: The corner of Narumi's mouth curved faintly as a calm, incisive gleam crossed her eyes.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "I have dealt with him for far too long not to know exactly what he fears—and what he covets."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase looked at the two people and asked softly:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Then what do we have in our hands that can scare him and is what he really wants?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka Jogu's eyes fell on the stack of old documents brought by Narumi.

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji pushed a thick stack of old documents to the center of the desktop.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "These are the research notes, meeting minutes, and records from the special ward that I kept. They are not enough to secure a legal conviction on their own, but several of the irregular arrangements documented here

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: would not survive a formal independent review."

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka Jogu flipped through a few pages and stopped at a signature column.

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "There are several arrangements here, sign your own name."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji did not try to cover the page, and her tone was calm and cold:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "I knew exactly what I was signing, and I don't need to excuse myself. But it is precisely because it has my signed name and handling records that Hirasaka cannot deny that this batch of materials is forged. Once it

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: comes to independent verification, I dare to bear my share of the price - and his current academic status cannot afford to bet on this consequence."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren lowered her eyes. Sakaguchi listened in silence without interrupting.

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka Jogu closed the file and nodded:

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "There are original handling records of the parties involved, which cannot be easily overturned through professional verification procedures."

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "These materials, plus the personal testimony of Narumi and Ren, are enough to make Hirasaka afraid. But if only a few of us have it, he may not be truly afraid. We need to let these materials fall into the hands of

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: people who have enough influence and are willing to intervene in the investigation when necessary."

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka Jogu stood up and walked to the cabinet and took out an old business card album.

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "When I took over Hoshimi Hospital, my mother not only handed over this hospital to me, but also introduced me to several close friends she had made in the medical field. My mother told me that if one day I encounter

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: something that I cannot solve alone, I can ask her close friends for help."

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka turned over a few pages and read out three names:

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "Professor Shizuko Takamine, Professor Tsunehiko Kanbara, and Director Chikage Shirakawa."

speaker: Narrator
text: The three of them were silent for a while.

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji raised her head first:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "...Professor Gao Feng? The one who previously chaired a national academic conference in the field of pelvic surgery and gynecological difficult and severe diseases?"

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "I read Professor Kanbara's clinical research standards when I was studying abroad. His judgment will be taken seriously by the industry."

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "Director Shirakawa and my mother have been close friends for years. She once said that if a young Hoshimi doctor suffered an injustice, she would at least hear the facts. We can ask those three senior colleagues to

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: review the materials and hold them independently. As long as Hirasaka knows all three are prepared to intervene in a formal investigation if necessary, he will not dare act recklessly."

speaker: Narrator
text: Just at this moment, there was a knock on the door.

speaker: Narrator
text: Kaori Miyama—Asuka's close friend, who also knew the circumstances behind Narumi and Ren's employment—entered the room.

speaker: Kaori Miyama
text: "Sorry, Director. I just heard that you were discussing outside assistance."

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "Kaori? What's wrong?"

speaker: Kaori Miyama
text: "If I really need it, I can also try to talk to my father. I can't guarantee that he will agree to help, let alone what he can do, but I can at least ask."

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka Jogu smiled gently:

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "Thank you, Kaori. For now, Professor Takamine and the other two senior colleagues will be enough. There is no need to involve my uncle yet."

speaker: Kaori Miyama
text: "Understood. Call me anytime you need me."

speaker: Narrator
text: She closed the door and left.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren glanced toward the door and spoke quietly.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "...Everyone is helping us."

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Yeah."

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka Jogu did not appear relaxed:

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "The problem is that, now that we have a credible threat of independent review to keep Hirasaka from acting recklessly, we still need the other half: what research result can we offer as the price that makes him

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: willing to stop? He is a gynecology specialist, so what he wants most is probably a project that can advance his academic standing..."

speaker: Narrator
text: The office door was suddenly pushed open.

speaker: Narrator
text: Aqua Mizuki walked in holding a laptop and a stack of scattered printed manuscripts.

speaker: Aqua Mizuki
text: "Asuka! I came to return the portable drive I borrowed. I thought I heard something interesting as I passed the door. Are you looking for gynecological research? I have plenty!"

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji was startled:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "…A lot?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Aqua had already set her computer on the desk and begun opening folders one after another.

speaker: Aqua Mizuki
text: "This is a theoretical model for stratifying pelvic imaging; this one predicts tissue-recovery cycles statistically; and this... oh, this is the paper I said I would submit to an international conference last time."

speaker: Narrator
text: Page after page of charts, models, and neat analysis results pop up on the screen.

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka had been about to send her back out, but the third document made her stop.

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "...Wait a minute. This research has been completed?"

speaker: Aqua Mizuki
text: "It's done."

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "Then why have I never seen you submit any articles?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Aqua Mizuki thought for a while:

speaker: Aqua Mizuki
text: "Huh? Didn't I vote?"

speaker: Narrator
text: She opened her email and searched for a while, then clapped her hands in sudden realization.

speaker: Aqua Mizuki
text: "Ah! It turns out that after I finished writing the cover letter, I ran to do the next interesting experiment and kept it in the draft box!"

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "...Draft box?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Aqua Mizuki scrolled down the folder for a long time:

speaker: Aqua Mizuki
text: "Well, the following articles are also there."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji took a typescript and read two pages carefully:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "The ideas are fascinating, but most of the work focuses on imaging models and theoretical inference."

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka Jogu covered her forehead:

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "Aqua...What do you think of an academic paper?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Aqua Mizuki blinked:

speaker: Aqua Mizuki
text: "Hmm... the notes you left behind after you figured out a curious question?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase finally couldn't help but smile.

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka Jogu sighed:

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "I'm beginning to think that the research community's failure to discover you is its loss—and a serious failure on my part as director."

speaker: Narrator
text: Aqua Mizuki saw the seriousness on several people's faces and patted the computer happily:

speaker: Aqua Mizuki
text: "I do not know who you are negotiating with, but if you need to offer Hirasaka a research project, I can pull one from my draft folder. I have plenty more anyway."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji gently put the printed manuscript back on the table and looked at Aqua.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Thank you, Dr. Mizuki. But put your main project away for now."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji took another neatly bound research draft from her folder. Its paper edges were worn from repeated handling, and the pages were densely covered in revision notes of several colors.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "What really makes Hirasaka bite is not a simple theoretical model, but the one in my hand - "Layered Surgical Strategy for Treatment of Complex Pelvic Endometriosis Lesions and Preservation of Ovarian Function."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase took a gentle breath:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Doctor Narumi... Isn't this the article you have always wanted to finish? You were organizing it when you were in the old hospital. After coming to Hoshimi, you often changed your rest time..."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji smiled faintly:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "I was discovered by you."

speaker: Narrator
text: Aqua read several pages closely and, unusually for her, did not interrupt at once. After a moment, she spoke with complete seriousness.

speaker: Aqua Mizuki
text: "This clinical surgical stratification strategy... is far more grounded than my theoretical model. It was built piece by piece through years of work at the operating table."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji Sakaguchi frowned and said:

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Wait. I was the one who suggested offering him a research benefit, but I never expected you to bring out this project. You spent years building it."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji looked up at him, her gaze clear and composed:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "I have thought it through. Then and now, I have always calculated the price I am willing to pay with clear eyes."

speaker: Narrator
text: She placed the research paper in the center of the table.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "First, if we hand over Aqua's principal project, Hirasaka will immediately realize that Hoshimi has someone capable of producing new bargaining chips at any time. That would not be a truce; it would be inviting a

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: predator through the door. Second, Hirasaka is a pelvic surgeon himself. He spent years trying—and failing—to establish a tissue-preserving layered approach for deep lesions. Only this unique clinical protocol,

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: which cost me years of work, will convince him that he has gained the better end of the bargain. And only my willingness to surrender priority leadership over the project I kept in reserve will make him understand

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: that I am determined to buy a permanent end to his interference."

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "If you give up the initiative of first verification and priority publication, your loss is really too great."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji showed a little bitter smile:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "I read all the modification records again last night. To be honest, I couldn't bear to part with it. I still feel pain when I think about it. But you have to pay real money to make a deal - if you give up its first

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: verification and priority publishing opportunities, I can get him to shut up completely and let us continue to work here with peace of mind. I accept this price."

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka Jogu said seriously:

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "Even at that price, the intellectual-property boundaries must be explicit. You may yield only priority leadership for the first validation and publication of the unpublished method framework and aggregate analysis.

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: Your genuine original contribution must remain fully credited under ordinary research-collaboration standards, and neither the original research drafts nor the patients' source data can ever become bargaining goods."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji nodded:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "I've already considered this."

speaker: Narrator
text: Aqua Mizuki suddenly raised her hand:

speaker: Aqua Mizuki
text: "How about this? Narumi's irreplaceable surgical strategy must remain the main course, but I can extract a limited postoperative-recovery assessment parameter table from my drafts and append it, saving him some

speaker: Aqua Mizuki
text: statistical work during validation."

speaker: Narrator
text: She looked at Narumi and added with bright eyes: "Also, when this matter is over, can we work on the next article together? There are two places in the layering method you just mentioned that I think I can continue to

speaker: Narrator
text: study - I am not trying to compensate you for anything, I really want to try it!"

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase laughed:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Doctor Aqua, does this count as inviting someone to work overtime together?"

speaker: Aqua Mizuki
text: "Eh? Does it count?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji looked down at her research manuscript, and after a while, she also smiled:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "...Okay. Let's wait until this matter is over."

speaker: Narrator
text: After Aqua left, the four of them completely finalized the bottom line and advancement method of the negotiations.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "For this kind of gray private truce, there is no need to enter into a complicated formal settlement contract. It is enough to clearly explain the rules on the upper and lower levels of the table through an

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: intermediary."

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka Jogu nodded:

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "Exactly. The first layer is the private understanding: he immediately ends every investigation into Hoshimi Hospital, sends no one else to approach Narumi or Ren directly or indirectly, and does not harass Ms.

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: Kunizuka or any of our current patients and colleagues."

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "In exchange, the former-hospital records bearing my signature will be entrusted to Professor Takamine and the other two senior colleagues for independent safekeeping. As long as he follows the rules, the material

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: will never be made public. If he reaches out again, the three of them can initiate a formal professional review at any time."

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "The second layer is the formal research collaboration: subject to compliance review by neutral senior colleagues, Narumi will grant him leadership of the first validation and priority publication for the unpublished

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: methodological framework and aggregate analysis of her stratified surgical strategy, together with Aqua's supporting parameter table. Narumi's genuine original contribution will be credited through the normal

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: research-collaboration process, the original drafts will remain at Hoshimi, and no patient-identifying information will be involved."

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka Jogu puts down the pen:

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "It not only gives him a high-value academic achievement that he can handle with dignity, but also puts the knife of verification above his head. Let the intermediary arrange a phone call with him based on this

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: framework."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase looked at the outline on the desktop:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "...Will this end?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji reached out and rested her hand gently over the back of Ren's hand:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "We cannot appeal to his conscience, but we can make him calculate the costs and benefits. This time, we hold the leverage."

speaker: Narrator
text: A few days later, through a professional intermediary introduced by Asuka's mother's old friend, the two parties arranged an undisclosed remote call.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji Hirasaka did not come to Hoshimi in person. The screen displayed only a single line with the participant's name, while his voice came through the speaker.

speaker: Ryuji Hirasaka
text: "It has been a long time, Dr. Jinguji. Nurse Nanase as well. I did not expect to find both of you doing so well."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase did not answer.

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "Today is not for you to care about their personal lives."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji Hirasaka laughed lightly:

speaker: Ryuji Hirasaka
text: "I heard that Ms. Kunizuka underwent a highly successful operation at your hospital. Should I offer Hoshimi my thanks?"

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Doctors take care of their patients, no strings attached."

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka sent the research-collaboration summary to the other party through the conference sharing window.

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "You have confirmed that Narumi and Ren are here, and we know that you sent people to investigate them. These are the research-collaboration terms we can offer. Meanwhile, Professor Takamine, Professor Kanbara, and

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: Director Shirakawa have been entrusted to hold the relevant former-hospital records independently."

speaker: Narrator
text: There was silence over the speaker. After a while, Hirasaka spoke again.

speaker: Ryuji Hirasaka
text: "Preserved stratified treatment of deep pelvic lesions...it turns out that you have achieved this level. The clinical value of this study is probably higher than what you wrote in the abstract. Are you really willing

speaker: Ryuji Hirasaka
text: to give up the leading opportunity for first verification and priority publication?"

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Within the scope stated in the summary, I am willing."

speaker: Ryuji Hirasaka
text: "Why?"

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Because I don't want to spend the rest of my time on you. You will get a unique result worthy of careful study, and we will get space to continue working and living."

speaker: Narrator
text: A faint sneer came from the speaker.

speaker: Ryuji Hirasaka
text: "The terms sound very tempting. However, Narumi, since we have to negotiate clearly, it would be too stingy to only give me the methodological framework and follow-up verification rights. Why not hand over the

speaker: Ryuji Hirasaka
text: original case manuscript you have to me, and then withdraw the old data sent to the three seniors - wouldn't that be more sincere?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji didn't even blink her eyelids, her voice was cold and determined:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "If I hand over the original drafts and withdraw the old records held by those three senior colleagues, you will send a third person to Hoshimi tomorrow, won't you? Dr. Hirasaka, we know one another too well. Only if

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: the old hospital records bearing even my own signature remain in Professor Takamine's hands, while priority publication leadership is transferred to you in stages through a normal collaboration process, will the

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: tension remain balanced fairly."

speaker: Ryuji Hirasaka
text: "Those old records you handed in, if they really come to the stage of verification, you yourself can't get away with it, right?"

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Verify whatever needs to be verified, including my part back then. I can afford to pay my price, but you can't afford it with your current status."

speaker: Narrator
text: The other end of the speaker was silent for a long time, and then Hirasaka whispered with some scrutiny:

speaker: Ryuji Hirasaka
text: "...I thought hiding in that kind of gentle little hospital would blunt your claws. It seems you haven't changed at all, Narumi Jinguji. After all, you are still as ruthless as before."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji did not deny it, but answered calmly:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "I just put my thoughts on things more worthy of calculation."

speaker: Narrator
text: There was silence for a moment, and the voice of Hirasaka came again:

speaker: Ryuji Hirasaka
text: "...Ren. You have not said a word this whole time."

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Dr. Hirasaka."

speaker: Ryuji Hirasaka
text: "Don't you have anything to say to me?"

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Yes. Please don't come to me again in the future. This is not a decision made by Dr. Narumi for me, it is my own decision."

speaker: Narrator
text: There was a moment of silence on the other end of the speaker.

speaker: Ryuji Hirasaka
text: "...That's it."

speaker: Narrator
text: After a few seconds, his voice returned to its usual restraint:

speaker: Ryuji Hirasaka
text: "Very well. I have no interest in a bargain that harms us both. I accept your terms. From this moment on, I will stop investigating Hoshimi and send no one else after either of you. Kunizuka's errands for me end here

speaker: Ryuji Hirasaka
text: as well. The research authorization and authorship will proceed through the normal academic-collaboration process."

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "The intermediary has been recorded. As long as both parties abide by the tacit understanding, the materials kept by the three seniors will never be opened."

speaker: Ryuji Hirasaka
text: "Got it."

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Goodbye, Dr. Hirasaka."

speaker: Narrator
text: It was quiet for a moment.

speaker: Ryuji Hirasaka
text: "Goodbye, Dr. Jinguji."

speaker: Narrator
text: Communication is disconnected.

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka Jogu looked at the darkened call window and let out a breath:

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: "This is not a sudden realization of conscience on his part. He has figured out that it is not worthwhile to continue pursuing the case."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi gave a small nod.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "It is much more reliable to let him calculate the pros and cons than to expect his conscience to find out."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi Kunizuka has recovered well and has completed the formal discharge procedures.

speaker: Narrator
text: Before leaving the hospital, she pushed her small suitcase to say goodbye to the three of them.

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "I have truthfully reported the situation here to Dr. Hirasaka during the past few days in the hospital. However, he suddenly informed me two days ago that I will no longer be required to be responsible for any

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: contact with you in the future."

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Yes. This is just the right time to rest peacefully."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji handed her the discharge follow-up form:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Come back next month for your postoperative follow-up on the date shown here. If you feel any discomfort while recovering, contact the outpatient clinic at once."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi accepted the follow-up form and looked at the three of them, who were acting as though nothing unusual had happened. She blinked in surprise.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase smiled gently:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "Be careful on the road, Ms. Kunizuka."

speaker: Narrator
text: Yayoi Kunizuka was silent for a moment and solemnly nodded to the three of them:

speaker: Yayoi Kunizuka
text: "...Thank you for taking this time."

speaker: Narrator
text: She pushed the small suitcase and turned towards the elevator.

speaker: Narrator
text: When Ryuji Sakaguchi pushed the door in, he saw Narumi Jinguji organizing the bookshelf.

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi was putting the old dark-colored binder that had given up the control of first verification and priority publication into the upper shelf of the bookshelf for filing. her fingers paused on the spine for a

speaker: Narrator
text: moment, and then she placed a brand new blank notebook at hand.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "New topic?"

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "The directions we made with Dr. Aqua have just been outlined."

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Any surgeon would be upset if I handed over the core topic that I have been working on for several years to that kind of person."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji breathed out gently, and a trace of real regret flashed in her eyes:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "It's not just a fire, it hurts like hell. It's been years of clinical effort, and it's not something you can just put down and laugh off."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji stopped looking at the old binder and turned to look at Ryuji Sakaguchi, her expression returning to her usual calmness and vigor.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Still, I made the calculation and signed this agreement myself, so I will honor it. I may have surrendered priority publication leadership, but I still have my clinical experience and the scalpel in my hand. What I

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: have lost, I will earn back piece by piece at Hoshimi's operating tables."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji Sakaguchi nodded:

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "If you need case accumulation and collaboration with colleagues, please come to me at any time."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji raised her eyebrows slightly:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Let me be clear in advance, Dr. Sakaguchi: the next time we are in the operating room, I will still point out every problem that needs to be addressed."

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "That's just what I want."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji looked at him, her voice softening:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "And thank you for not lecturing me or treating us as people who can do nothing but accept protection."

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Neither are you."

speaker: Narrator
text: A faint smile touched the corner of Narumi's lips.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "...I like that answer."

speaker: Narrator
text: The office door opened and Ren Nanase poked her head inside.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "You two! If there is no urgent surgery right now, could you come to the lounge and help me with a very serious problem?"

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "What's the problem?"

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: "I bought three sandwiches for us. Then Dr. Mizuki heard there was food and followed me. She is standing outside the lounge with her laptop, saying she can show us three papers she just finished while we eat—and that

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: this time she even remembered to submit them!"

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "...Three papers?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi laughed so hard that she had to steady herself against the bookshelf.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Let's go. We cannot let her put the sandwiches on top of her papers."

speaker: Narrator
text: The three of them left the surgical office together and headed toward the lively staff lounge.

speaker: Narrator
text: A soft night rain pattered beyond the wooden lattice window, while warm yellow paper lanterns cast a gentle glow over the table in the izakaya's half-private booth.

speaker: Narrator
text: The aromas of grilled chicken skewers and salt-roasted ginkgo nuts mingled with the warmth of sake, slowly spreading between the narrow wooden tables.

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi Jinguji was not wearing the plain glasses she occasionally used for reading papers at the hospital, nor her immaculate white coat. A fitted, deep burgundy knit dress traced her mature figure. Resting her cheek

speaker: Narrator
text: on one hand, she regarded him through lightly tipsy eyes with a languor rarely seen in the clinic.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Here, Chief Surgeon Sakaguchi. This one is on me."

speaker: Narrator
text: She lifted the sake flask and unhurriedly filled Ryuji Sakaguchi's shallow cup, her fingertip seeming to brush the back of his hand by accident.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji lifted his cup.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Why so formal all of a sudden? I thought tonight was just an ordinary dinner out."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi took a small sip, leaving a faint sheen on the rim of the porcelain cup.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "I've called you 'Dr. Sakaguchi' all week at the hospital. On the rare Sunday night when I don't have to read charts or listen to Aqua go on about her data model, of course I deserve a proper treat."

speaker: Narrator
text: The corners of her eyes lifted as she appraised him with an enigmatic smile.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Or have you grown so used to seeing me in scrubs, Dr. Sakaguchi, that you don't recognize me in a different outfit?"

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "I was only thinking that, dressed like this, you're even harder to look away from than you are in the surgical office."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi laughed and leaned slightly forward, the neckline of her dress forming an elegant curve.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Such a sweet talker. It seems your overseas training taught more than how to hold a scalpel."

speaker: Narrator
text: They chatted over several small dishes, moving from the latest troublesome family in the outpatient clinic to the laptop Aqua had nearly ruined with sandwich mayonnaise. The mood was relaxed and familiar.

speaker: Narrator
text: After several rounds of drinks, Ryuji recalled a name he had seen on the day's roster and asked casually.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Come to think of it, Nurse Nanase wasn't scheduled today either, was she? I assumed the two of you often went out together when you had weekends off."

speaker: Narrator
text: The smile on Narumi's face abruptly faded.

speaker: Narrator
text: She set down her cup, narrowed her beautiful eyes, and deliberately glared at him with feigned displeasure in her voice.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Talking about another woman while you're on a date with one?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji froze for a moment.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "I only happened to—"

speaker: Narrator
text: At the sight of him suddenly at a loss for words, Narumi could no longer contain the mischief in her eyes. She burst into laughter and lightly tapped the table with one fingertip.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "I'm teasing. It was only a joke. Look how nervous you got."

speaker: Narrator
text: She picked up her cup again, rubbing the warm porcelain with her thumb as genuine warmth and concern gradually entered her expression.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji

text: "Then you underestimate me, Dr. Sakaguchi. If I only wanted to repay you for helping at the negotiating table, I could take a few troublesome surgeries off your hands or add your name to a new research project. I,

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: Narumi Jinguji, have kept accounts my entire life. I can still tell the difference between a debt of gratitude and a set of bedsheets."

speaker: Narrator
text: She lowered her head and lightly kissed Ryuji's lips, pure delight spreading through her eyes.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "So don't think of this as repayment. I simply like you."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji stared for a moment, then clasped the hand resting on his chest.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "...Is it really that simple?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi nestled back into his arms, found the most comfortable position, and closed her eyes. Her voice was languid but certain.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "It is that simple. I wanted you, and I wanted to hold you, so I did. What, is Chief Surgeon Sakaguchi dissatisfied with that reason?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji laughed and tightened his arms around her.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "No. I couldn't be more satisfied."

speaker: Narrator
text: Monday morning at Hoshimi Hospital was as busy and orderly as ever.

speaker: Narrator
text: When Ryuji returned to the surgical office after morning handover, Narumi was already at her desk in plain glasses, intently reviewing the preoperative assessment for the afternoon's abdominal-wall hernia repair.

speaker: Narrator
text: Every button of her white coat was fastened with impeccable precision, and her long hair was neatly tied back. Even the faint mark still lingering on her neck from the previous night was completely hidden beneath her

speaker: Narrator
text: collar.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji walked over to her desk.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Good morning, Dr. Jinguji."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi looked up, met his eyes calmly and naturally, and offered a standard professional smile.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Good morning, Dr. Sakaguchi. Perfect timing. The repeat coagulation panel for the patient in bed three just came back. Take a look."

speaker: Narrator
text: There were no lingering, suggestive looks, no shyness after becoming intimate, and no special treatment.

speaker: Narrator
text: She picked up her red-and-blue pencil and crisply indicated two details on the lab report and preoperative plan.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "The patient stopped anticoagulants two hours later than planned last night. The current INR is barely within the safe range, but your preoperative plan lists only conventional gelatin sponge as backup for bleeding in

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: the preperitoneal space. To be safe, I suggest having the scrub nurse prepare an additional bipolar cautery set and absorbable hemostatic gauze."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji looked down and checked the figures.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "You're right. I overlooked that. Add what you suggested."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi nodded, closed the chart after signing her review, and handed it back to him.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Everything else is fine. I'm going to make rounds on the ward. I'll see you in the operating room this afternoon."

speaker: Narrator
text: Watching her leave the office with the chart held in her arms, composed and capable, Ryuji remained where he was with a subtle sense of confusion.

speaker: Narrator
text: She was clearly neither angry nor deliberately distancing herself from him. Yet compared with the woman who had whispered, 'I simply like you,' beside his ear in a hotel bed the night before, Dr. Jinguji was being

speaker: Narrator
text: almost excessively professional.

speaker: Narrator
text: It was not until half past noon, after lunch, that Ryuji encountered Narumi again around a corridor corner.

speaker: Narrator
text: She carried two warm cans of black coffee. Seeing no one nearby, she slipped one into his hand and murmured.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "The breeze is pleasant up there. If you have a moment, come have coffee with me on the roof."

speaker: Narrator
text: Afternoon sunlight covered the open hospital roof. A breeze stirred the chain-link fence, carrying the distant noise of the city.

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi leaned against the rooftop railing, opened her can, and took a small sip of warm coffee.

speaker: Narrator
text: Hearing the rooftop door open behind her, she turned. At last, her eyes held the same teasing intimacy as the night before.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "What is it, Chief Surgeon Sakaguchi? You've spent the whole morning secretly watching my expression. Are you wondering if last night was only a pleasant dream?"

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji stepped beside her and leaned against the railing.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "You were so merciless when you picked apart my preoperative plan this morning that I wondered whether my performance last night had been unsatisfactory."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi burst into laughter and lowered her voice for a teasing retort.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Don't worry. If I were grading last night, you would already have a perfect score. As for criticizing you this morning, you really did omit the hemostasis contingency from your plan."

speaker: Narrator
text: Once their laughter subsided, Narumi turned away, holding the warm coffee can in both hands as she looked down at the hospital's bright, immaculate courtyard.

speaker: Narrator
text: The breeze lifted a few loose strands along her cheek. Her voice became calm and serious.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Ryuji, I wasn't trying to put on airs in the office this morning. But as long as I am at work and still wearing this white coat, I want to devote myself to being a good doctor."

speaker: Narrator
text: She paused, sincere warmth entering her eyes.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "I know better than anyone how badly my reputation and circumstances had deteriorated when Ren and I left our previous hospital. Asuka knew perfectly well that I had a difficult past, yet she hired us in spite of all

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: the criticism and gave me a clean desk and operating table here at Hoshimi... I don't want to betray that trust."

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji listened in silence and nodded gently.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "I understand. During working hours, we are colleagues and partners first."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi turned toward him, a soft curve appearing at her lips.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Yes. And isn't our private affection more interesting when we save it for outside working hours?"

speaker: Narrator
text: She took half a step closer to Ryuji.

speaker: Narrator
text: The distance between them closed until they could hear each other's breathing. Narumi raised her face slightly, watched him in silence, and spoke softly.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "And you don't need to feel burdened by anything that happened last night. There truly isn't anything I want from you. Just spend time with me when you can. If I genuinely wanted something from you, it would not be

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: this relaxed and easy."

speaker: Narrator
text: She delivered the final sentence slowly and softly. It sounded playful and suggestive, yet underneath lay a quiet edge and a trace of danger.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji looked at her smiling face, now inches from his own, and answered without flinching.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: "Then I should be grateful that, for now, Dr. Jinguji only wants me to drink coffee with her."

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi narrowed her eyes in satisfaction and lightly tapped the lapel of his white coat with one slender finger.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: "Good that you understand. Lunch break is almost over. I'll see you at the operating table this afternoon. And if your attention wanders during the procedure, I still won't spare your pride, Dr. Sakaguchi."

speaker: Narrator
text: Leaving him with that playful warning, she tossed the empty can into the recycling bin by the door, opened the rooftop door, and disappeared down the stairs with her usual composed stride.
